state: state_s=start_s; n extrema and dilute occupancy at beginning of interval; next extrema/storage/inventory/cumulative delivery at end_s
flux: Signed outward native pressure-matrix conservative face flux; full basket, no clipping. Reverse fields are nonnegative magnitude.
courant: dt sum(max(outward face flux,0))/(porosity*cell volume), including processor faces; global maximum
topology: Only radial aggregate observe/coupled. No legacy aggregate_intervals.csv or series-resistance oracle. Uniform/axial schemas unchanged.
dilute: pore-volume occupancy below w=.10; constant uniform porosity cancels from volume ratio; not measured-data coverage
observe: mu_n and mu_next are local diagnostic law evaluations; constant liquid viscosity remains applied in observe mode
transverse: RESTRICTED AUXILIARY DIAGNOSTIC: transverse_abs_internal_flux_m3_s selects internal faces using abs(Sf.x()) < VSMALL, with the corresponding selector on processor faces. Selected internal faces are counted once; selected processor faces are counted half per rank before global/full-basket scaling. This strict face-normal test can omit geometrically transverse faces with small nonzero axial area-vector components. It is not complete transverse exchange, net core-annulus transfer, or a solute provenance measure. The retained independent review reports approximately 10.59% undercount in the final short-fixture interval ending at 0.2 s; this is fixture-specific, not an all-case error bound or correction factor. EXCHANGE.json and tools/sci_md_rheology_006/exchange.py document the separate structured-fixture reconstruction: water 9.876964920381905e-10 m3/s and upwind advective solute 1.6012777957101985e-8 kg/s. The latter excludes diffusive flux and is not total solute exchange. This restricted statistic is not an input to primary flow-share scores or allowance construction and does not control native pressure/transport or the all-face outgoing Courant calculation; its limitation does not alter the MATERIAL decisions. Post-result documentation clarification only: the emitted calculation is unchanged, not repaired.
